Looking at the diff, the controller has no strong parameters or validation to ensure the embeddable_host envelope exists before accessing nested keys. This is a real bug - if a malformed request is sent without the embeddable_host wrapper, params[:embeddable_host] returns nil, and calling [:host] on nil raises NoMethodError, resulting in a 500 error instead of a proper 400 client error.
